description: Populations at Risk is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Headwaters Economics; Kresge Foundation. Adaptation practitioners can use this tool to gather fine-scale information about populations within geographies of interest. Reports from the tool can be useful in developing city-wide vulnerability assessments that show which populations may experience adverse social, health, or economic outcomes due to race, age, gender, poverty status, or other factors. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Vector-Borne Disease, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
